messages:
harper: Putting up a quick bug/ux flag from the latest usability run: the min/max numerals on the autoscale card have low contrast against the card bg and users glossed over the "max (burst)" hint. Screenshot in the thread. Thoughts on stronger affordance?

drew: Agreed. Two quick options: 1) increase weight of the numbers and add a subtle separator between guaranteed vs burst, or 2) keep weight but add a small horizontal pill that says 'max (may burst)' with a dotted underline to indicate more info. Leaning toward (1) for legibility.

em: If we boost weight we must watch visual hierarchy so the SLO slider doesn't lose prominence entirely. Proposal: make the allocation numbers semibold and color them the primary text color, keep slider track muted. Also add a tiny inline info icon after "max" that opens a micro-popover with the single line: "Burst uses spare GPUs; may be unavailable or incur extra cost."

ryan: Implementation note: micro-popover should not shift layout. Use absolute-positioned panel that appears over content. For mobile, convert popover to an inline expandable row. Also prefer focus management: focus moves into the popover on open, returns to the icon on close.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for the numerals. 2) Info icon must be keyboard operable (Enter/Space) and have aria-expanded state. 3) Popover should be announced with role="dialog" and a succinct aria-label like "Burst details". 4) Provide aria-describedby on the max label linking to the popover so screen readers get immediate context.

harper: Quick microcopy tweak: change "Max" to "Max (may burst)" inline, and popover copy: "Burst: temporary extra GPUs for short spikes. Might increase hourly cost." Keep it short.

em: Small prototype change: I'll push a frame with semibold numbers + info icon and muted slider tonight. Can someone check the contrast spec before I finalize?

drew: I'll run the contrast checks and hand results to em. Also will add a small hover state that shows estimated cost delta next to the popover trigger.

a11y-bot: Remember to include a visible focus style on the icon with at least 3px outline and do not rely on color alone.

harper: Great. Action items: @em update Figma with semibold numerals + info icon + micro-popover, @drew run contrast & add cost preview, @ryan spec focus behavior for mobile/desktop, @a11y-bot to validate in the a11y pass. We'll reconvene after the prototype is posted. :white_check_mark:
